sentences.text: Rinconsaurus was an unusually slender sauropod compared to others of its kind.
This animal is distinguished by unique tail vertebrae with bony processes.
Fossils of Rinconsaurus were discovered in 1997 near Rincón de los Sauces in Neuquén province, Argentina.
The species Rinconsaurus caudamirus was described in 2003 based on three partial skeletons.
Fossilized dung from titanosaurids suggests Rinconsaurus ate a diet including palms and grasses, leading to speculation about co-evolution with grasses.
Rinconsaurus is classified as a titanosaurid sauropod.
In 2007, some researchers assigned Rinconsaurus to the clade Aeolosauridae.
In 2007, some researchers assigned Rinconsaurus to the tribe Aeolosaurini within the subfamily Saltasaurinae.
Rinconsaurus is proposed to form a clade called Rinconsauria with Muyelensaurus, though this classification is not yet widely accepted.
In 2007, Calvo, González Riga, and Porfiri erected a clade named Rinconsauria for Rinconsaurus and Muyelensaurus.
Rinconsaurus was a titanosaur sauropod that lived in Argentina during the Late Cretaceous.
Rinconsaurus lived approximately 83 million years ago during the Campanian stage of the Late Cretaceous in South America.
Rinconsaurus lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage.
